consoleScript:
fail=0
check() { if "$@"; then echo "PACKAGE_CHECK_PASS $*"; else echo "PACKAGE_CHECK_FAIL $*"; fail=$((fail+1)); fi; }
check test "$(id -u)" = 0
check /sbin/apk info --installed busybox apk-tools ca-certificates curl
check test ! -e /usr/bin/python3
check /sbin/apk update
check /bin/su -s /bin/sh -c 'sudo /sbin/apk add python3' admin
check /usr/bin/python3 -c 'import sys,json,zlib,hashlib,ssl,socket,pathlib; assert sys.version_info[:3]==(3,14,6); assert json.loads(json.dumps({"ok":37}))["ok"]==37; assert zlib.decompress(zlib.compress(b"wasm"))==b"wasm"; p=pathlib.Path("/tmp/python-package-proof");p.write_text("real Linux Python");assert p.read_text()=="real Linux Python";assert ssl.create_default_context().cert_store_stats()["x509_ca"]>0;print("NORMAL_PYTHON_OK",sys.executable,hashlib.sha256(b"wasm").hexdigest())'
check /sbin/apk del python3
check test ! -e /usr/bin/python3
check /sbin/apk add python3
check /bin/busybox sh -c 'echo package-home-survives > /home/admin/package-persistence-test'
sync
echo PACKAGE_SMOKE_EXIT status=$fail
poweroff -f
restartScript:
fail=0
check() { if "$@"; then echo "PACKAGE_CHECK_PASS $*"; else echo "PACKAGE_CHECK_FAIL $*"; fail=$((fail+1)); fi; }
check test ! -e /usr/bin/python3
if /sbin/apk info --installed python3; then echo PACKAGE_CHECK_FAIL python-database-survived; fail=$((fail+1)); else echo PACKAGE_CHECK_PASS python-database-reset; fi
check /sbin/apk info --installed busybox apk-tools ca-certificates curl
check /bin/busybox grep -F package-home-survives /home/admin/package-persistence-test
check /bin/busybox rm /home/admin/package-persistence-test
sync
echo PACKAGE_SMOKE_EXIT status=$fail
poweroff -f
